title: Auto-advancing tabs with a visible clock
summary: Tabs that auto-advance on a linear `scaleX` 0 → 1 bar that is the timer, start once in view, hold on hover / keyboard focus / off-screen / pause button, restart on click; `role="tab"` with arrow keys, no autoplay under reduced motion
variants: tab set with a panel beside it (this)
accordion: the bar sits under the open row and the body opens in place
scroll-driven: sticky-stage progress picks the tab, a click jumps the scroll to that tab's window
